description: This file defines classes and methods for processing test expectations and results JSON data related to layout tests, including fetching, parsing, and analyzing flaky tests and unexpected results.

classes.name: ResultsJSON
classes.description: Handles parsing and walking through the results.json data structure, providing methods to access test results and expectations.

classes.name: BotTestExpectationsFactory
classes.description: Factory class to fetch and create BotTestExpectations objects from test result URLs based on builder names.

classes.name: BotTestExpectations
classes.description: Analyzes test results JSON to identify flaky tests, unexpected results, and generate expectation lines for reporting.

methods.name: ResultsJSON.__init__
methods.description: Initializes with builder name and JSON dictionary of results.

methods.name: ResultsJSON._walk_trie
methods.description: Recursively walks through the nested trie structure of test results.

methods.name: ResultsJSON.walk_results
methods.description: Yields full test paths and their corresponding result data.

methods.name: ResultsJSON.expectation_for_type
methods.description: Returns the expectation string for a given result type character.

methods.name: ResultsJSON.occurances_and_type_from_result_item
methods.description: Extracts run-length and result type from a result item.

methods.name: BotTestExpectationsFactory._results_json_for_port
methods.description: Fetches results JSON for a specific port name.

methods.name: BotTestExpectationsFactory._results_json_for_builder
methods.description: Fetches results JSON for a specific builder.

methods.name: BotTestExpectationsFactory.expectations_for_port
methods.description: Creates expectations object for a port, using fetched results JSON.

methods.name: BotTestExpectationsFactory.expectations_for_builder
methods.description: Creates expectations object for a builder.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations.__init__
methods.description: Initializes with results JSON, builders, and optional specifiers.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations.flakes_by_path
methods.description: Identifies flaky tests with at least two distinct results.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations.unexpected_results_by_path
methods.description: Finds tests with unexpected results and returns their expectations.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations.all_results_by_path
methods.description: Returns all distinct result types for each test.

methods.name: BotTestExpectations.expectation_lines
methods.description: Generates expectation lines for flaky tests.

methods.name: _all_types_in_results
methods.description: Extracts all result types from run-length encoded results, ignoring certain types.

methods.name: _result_to_enum
methods.description: Converts a result string to its enum value.

methods.name: _flaky_types_in_results
methods.description: Determines flaky result types in a test entry, considering only very flaky if specified.
